resolution: Fixed compiled-game road ribbon parity: the standalone game showed roads as blocky stamped tiles (navy lanes + staircased yellow median) instead of the editor's smooth analytic ribbon. Root cause was the BAKE, in two parts. (1) The compiled game ships a BAKED floor texture (it can't run the Effect shader at load); the baker heightfieldTextureBytes painted ONLY per-cell tile-kind palette colours, never the analytic ribbon. Fixed by porting HEIGHTFIELD_TILE_SHADER's fragment function to JS (heightfieldTexelColor, beside the WGSL) and baking through it over [...tileData, ...roadRibbonSection(roads)] at 4px/tile = the editor capture resolution, so the textures are pixel-identical (incl. the RIBBONCAP overshoot guard). (2) FLAT painted floors render as per-cell flat-colour box slabs which structurally cannot show a ribbon; routed road-bearing flat chunks through the textured heightfield quad (floorNeedsHeightfieldRender = relief OR road), the same path relief floors + the editor use. Walkability untouched (flat chunk collider is the whole-chunk plane, independent of render; HEIGHTFIELDS slots disjoint from flatFields). No Zig change. Tests: worldGeometry 5/5 (new RIBBONBAKE test), worldColliders 4/4, roadData 26/26. User must re-run/re-compile the map to see it.
